Boca Raton Real Estate

Welcome to Boca Raton, Florida, a vibrant gem nestled in the heart of Palm Beach County. Known for its stunning beaches, luxurious lifestyle, and rich cultural scene, Boca Raton offers an unparalleled living experience that combines the best of coastal living with urban sophistication.

Boca Raton boasts a warm, inviting climate year-round, making it an ideal destination for those who enjoy outdoor activities. With miles of pristine shoreline, residents can indulge in sun-soaked days at the beach, partake in water sports, or simply unwind with a good book by the ocean. The city is also home to several beautiful parks and nature preserves, perfect for hiking, biking, or enjoying a leisurely picnic.

Culturally, Boca Raton is a hub of artistic expression and community engagement. The city is home to the renowned Boca Raton Museum of Art, which showcases an impressive collection of contemporary works, as well as the Mizner Park Amphitheater, where residents can enjoy concerts and events throughout the year. Dining enthusiasts will delight in the diverse culinary scene, featuring everything from upscale restaurants to charming cafes, ensuring there's something to satisfy every palate.

Boca Raton's real estate market is as diverse as its community, offering a range of options from luxurious waterfront estates to charming single-family homes and modern condominiums. With top-rated schools, a strong sense of community, and a wealth of amenities, it’s no wonder that Boca Raton is a sought-after destination for families, retirees, and professionals alike.

Experience the allure of Boca Raton—where coastal charm meets urban elegance. Discover your dream home in this enchanting city today!

Newest Listings in Boca Raton

$890,000
4 Beds ⋅ 3 Baths ⋅ B26042552 MLS
Beautiful 4-bedroom, 2.5-bath two-story lakefront home with a screened-in pool and Jacuzzi, offering breathtaking water views. This move-in-ready home features a formal dining room, spacious family room, 2-car garage, two new A/C units, fresh interior paint, updated light fixtures, and beautifully remodeled bathrooms. Enjoy Florida living at its finest in the highly desirable The Lakes at Boca Raton community, featuring resort-style amenities including a community pool, fitness center, playground, picnic and BBQ area, basketball courts, soccer field, and tennis courts. Basic cable is included. Conveniently located just 20 minutes from the beach and within one of Boca Raton's top-rated school districts, with access to some of the area's best schools.

18756 Cape Sable Drive, Boca Raton
$575,000
3 Beds ⋅ 2 Baths ⋅ B26042547 MLS ⋅ Country Landing Three BLDG.
This 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom single-story home offers 1,672 square feet of living space and is ready for your personal touches. Ideally located just steps from Powderhorn Park, residents enjoy access to playgrounds, sports fields, basketball courts, walking trails, picnic areas, and expansive green spaces. Situated within a highly sought-after West Boca Raton school district and conveniently located near shopping, dining, and major commuter routes, this property presents an excellent opportunity to renovate and create your dream home in one of Boca Raton's most established family-friendly communities.

11690 Timberwood Road, Boca Raton
$1,149,900
4 Beds ⋅ 3 Baths ⋅ B26042519 MLS
Welcome home to this extensively renovated lakefront home in the highly desired neighborhood of Island Lakes at Loggers Run. This home features brand new impact windows and doors, a new 5-ton A/C, water heater, garage door and opener, epoxy garage floor, new kitchen and laundry appliances, custom kitchen cabinetry with quartz countertops, fully renovated bathrooms, custom closets, luxury 40" x 40" tile throughout the main living areas, luxury laminate flooring in the bedrooms, and fresh interior paint. New sprinkler system. The roof was replaced in 2010. Move-in ready with major system upgrades and high-end finishes throughout. Low HOA and minutes from top schools, shops, restaurants and parks. Furnitures not included in the sale, enough room for a pool in the back.

11741 Island Lakes Lane, Boca Raton
$825,000
3 Beds ⋅ 3 Baths ⋅ B26042488 MLS
Are you looking for a home in Boca Pointe on a premium lot, backing to the lake with a fountain view and pool? If you said yes, come see this freshly painted home in Villa Flora! The move in ready blank canvas awaits your personal lifestyle. Enjoy the way the sun moves around the home as it creates an abundance of natural light. The layout is designed for effortless living with the expansive primary suite on the first level, giving you many years to enjoy time here. Upstairs, the oversized rooms are connected by a jack and jill bathroom with a versatile loft making it an ideal configuration for children or guests to have their own space. Convenience meets comfort with the indoor laundry room having a brand-new washer and dryer. Beyond the front door, you're minutes from premier shops, zoned for all A rated schools, local restaurants and major highways for an easy commute. Best of all, club membership at Boca Pointe is not mandatory! Come see why this lakefront gem is the ideal place to plant your roots!

6495 Via Rosa, Boca Raton
$259,900
2 Beds ⋅ 2 Baths ⋅ B26042464 MLS ⋅ Wwhisper Walk /Greenleaf BLDG.
Move right into this beautifully maintained, fully furnished villa in Whisper Walk and start enjoying the Florida lifestyle from day one. Offering 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, and a versatile den, this bright and inviting home features tile flooring throughout, updated kitchen and baths, a private patio perfect for morning coffee, and an open layout designed for comfortable living. Lightly used and exceptionally well cared for, pride of ownership is evident throughout. Recent improvements include a 2022 roof, 2025 A/C, New electrical panel, accordion shutters, and an impact skylight. Located on a quiet street just steps from the pool and clubhouse, residents enjoy Whisper Walk's amenities, including 11 lakes, tennis and pickleball courts, and an active social lifestyle. A truly turnkey!

18762 Candlewick Drive, Boca Raton
$3,190,000
5 Beds ⋅ 7 Baths ⋅ B26042423 MLS ⋅ Lotus Palms BLDG.
Completed in 2022 and reimagined through an extraordinary, no-expense-spared custom renovation, this one-of-a-kind Maldives model is the largest floor plan in Lotus, offering an unparalleled blend of sophisticated design, cutting-edge technology, and exceptional craftsmanship. Every detail has been thoughtfully curated to create a residence that is as functional as it is beautiful. Throughout the home, you'll find Lutron smart lighting and automated shades, all controlled from a phone or table, custom architectural soffits, oversized 4x4 Italian porcelain flooring, hardwood stairs and second-floor flooring, sleek glass railings, solid-core interior doors, upgraded sound insulation, and designer lighting creating an atmosphere of understated luxury. Pls hit the link to see the supplement. Perhaps the home's most remarkable feature is its professionally engineered recording studio, designed by David Frangioni of Modern Drummer Magazine. Perfect for playing instruments, recording music or making podcasts. Constructed as a true "room within a room," the studio features extensive acoustic engineering, soundproof construction, custom acoustic wall systems, isolated HVAC, professional recording infrastructure, and can easily be converted back into an additional bedroom with plumbing already in place for a future bathroom. The spectacular chef's kitchen was completely rebuilt with custom cabinetry, an oversized hidden pantry, coffee station, concealed storage, dramatic illuminated ceiling details, and a premium Wolf and Sub-Zero appliance package including a 48-inch dual-fuel range, two dishwashers, warming drawer, microwave, and built-in refrigeration. The primary suite serves as a private retreat with a completely redesigned spa-inspired bathroom featuring a custom-built sauna, soaking tub, oversized dual-head shower with floor-to-ceiling recessed niches, illuminated mirrors, and exceptional custom finishes. Additional custom features include an elegant designer powder room, dramatic foyer feature wall with floor-to-ceiling mirror, custom living room media wall with a Vapor Fireplace readiness and built-in surround sound, Dolby Atmos media room, custom office built-ins, upgraded bathrooms throughout, beautifully landscaped backyard with mature palms and mango tree, 3 balconies, and a 4-car garage. This is far more than a home—it is a custom luxury residence where every finish, system, and architectural detail has been elevated beyond builder standards, creating one of the most unique offerings available in Lotus.

17092 Five Waters Avenue, Boca Raton
$479,000
2 Beds ⋅ 3 Baths ⋅ B26042363 MLS ⋅ Mayfair BLDG.
This beautiful 2-bed, 2.5-bath residence is located in of Boca Raton's most desirable ocean area buildings with deeded beach access. This first floor unit features a covered patio with lush landscaping & an open patio area as well, a rare feature in most condominiums. This light & bright unit includes a kitchen with stainless steel appliances, wood cabinetry, granite counters & granite backsplash. Gorgeous marble flooring fills the common areas, while plush carpeting is in the bedroom suites. The oversized primary suite includes tropical garden views, ensuite bath & walk-in closet w/ custom built-ins. The laundry room includes a full-size washer/dryer, laundry tub and extra storage. This is a perfect opportunity to own a beach area retreat, just steps to the ocean! The Mayfair is a boutique condominium located on A1A with deeded beach access. This full-service building features a gorgeous atrium with lush tropical foliage and stunning water features. Mayfair's luxurious amenities include a beautiful social room, fitness center, heated pool, hot tub, covered BBQ / summer kitchen area, tennis, on-site manager & 24/7 security. 1401 S Ocean Boulevard Unit 1060, Boca Raton
$2,495,000
5 Beds ⋅ 7 Baths ⋅ B26042366 MLS ⋅ Lotus BLDG.
Rarely available and highly sought-after Laguna model in Lotus, featuring over $300,000 in upgrades and situated on an expansive lot with stunning lake views. This exceptional 5-bedroom, 6.5-bath residence offers the ultimate South Florida lifestyle with a huge resort-style pool and spa, spacious 3-car garage, and a sophisticated organic-modern design aesthetic throughout. From the moment you enter, abundant natural light fills the home as expansive sliding glass doors frame views of the backyard oasis and lake beyond. Outside, the oversized pool and spa take center stage against a beautiful lake-view backdrop, while the covered patio with a motorized retractable screen, cabana bath, built-in grill, and generous entertaining space create the perfect setting for year-round indoor-outdoor living. Designed for both everyday living and entertaining, the open-concept floor plan seamlessly blends elegance and functionality. The stunning chef's kitchen features warm custom wood cabinetry, a massive center island, gas cooktop, updated appliances, and extensive storage, flowing effortlessly into the main living areas and formal dining room. A stylish club room with custom built-ins provides additional gathering space, while a first-floor guest suite or office with an en-suite bath and walk-in closet offers flexibility. A custom-built mudroom off the garage adds both style and convenience. Upstairs, an expansive loft with a custom wood-paneled media wall opens to a large balcony overlooking the pool and lake. The luxurious primary suite is a true retreat, featuring dual walk-in closets and a spa-inspired bath with separate vanities, a dedicated makeup station, freestanding soaking tub, oversized shower, and designer finishes throughout. A rare opportunity to own one of Lotus' most desirable floor plans on a premium oversized lot with luxury upgrades, exceptional outdoor living, and beautiful lake views.

8568 Dream Falls Street, Boca Raton
$1,899,000
2 Beds ⋅ 2 Baths ⋅ B26042291 MLS ⋅ Chalfonte BLDG.
Welcome to this stunning turnkey 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom condo located in the prestigious ocean front Chalfonte in Boca Raton. Situated on the 19th floor, this open and spacious residence offers waterfront living with exceptional views of the sand and Atlantic ocean from every room. The entire home has been completely updated with a designer featuring: porcelain tile floors, quartz and quartzite countertops , impact windows, stainless-steel appliances custom built ins and more. Residents enjoy the benefit of private beach access, fitness center, tennis, full-service concierge and much more . The Chalfonte offers an outstanding opportunity for those seeking that Florida lifestyle just steps away from the Boca Raton, Lake Boca and a quick walk or bike to Mizner Park and downtown Boca Raton.

FIRST FLOOR. MOVE IN READY. COVERED PARKING. IMMACULATE JUMBO CONDO WITH BIG PATIO-FLORIDA ROOM, STEP OUT YOUR BACK DOOR TO SCREENED IN POOL AND SPA. WONDERFUL VIEW OF SPACIOUS BACK YARD. PREFERRED SOUTH EXPOSURE AT FLORIDA ROOM. ALL TILE FLOORING BEAUTIFUL EAT IN KITCHEN, GRANITE COUNTERS, STAINLESS APPLIANCES. LIVING ROOM AND MAIN BEDROOM SLIDING GLASS DOORS POCKET INTO WALLS. CLUB HOUSE; DANCE FLOOR; KITCHEN FOR CATERING WITH 2 STOVES AND 2 BBQs OUTSIDE OF KITCHEN; LARGE COVERED SCREEN PATIO.

9220 SW 14th Street Unit 3103, Boca Raton
$3,136,900
5 Beds ⋅ 8 Baths ⋅ B26042143 MLS ⋅ Lotus Edge BLDG.
Welcome to this exceptional waterfront residence in Lotus Edge, Boca Raton. The only brand-new, move-in-ready Santorini model currently available on the market, this highly sought-after floor plan offers the perfect blend of luxury, comfort, and sophisticated design. This stunning two-story home features 5 bedrooms, 7 bathrooms, and 5,453 square feet of beautifully finished living space. Designed for both everyday living and grand entertaining, the home showcases exquisite finishes throughout, expansive living areas, and multiple indoor and outdoor spaces ideal for hosting family and friends. The gourmet kitchen, elegant gathering spaces, and seamless indoor-outdoor flow create an exceptional lifestyle experience. A spacious four-car garage provides ample parking and storage. Situated on a premium waterfront lot, the property offers tranquil water views and the distinctive appeal of waterfront living within one of South Florida's most desirable new luxury communities. Residents enjoy access to Lotus Edge's world-class amenities, resort-style clubhouse, fitness center, pools, sports courts, and more. A rare opportunity to own one of the community's most desirable models without the wait of new construction. Some photos have been virtually staged.

9547 Riverside Park Drive, Boca Raton
$650,000
3 Beds ⋅ 4 Baths ⋅ B26042142 MLS ⋅ Tuscany Village BLDG.
Nestled within the gated community of Tuscany Village in desirable East Boca Raton, this beautifully maintained 3-bedroom, 3.5-bath townhome combines spacious living with effortless convenience. Designed with timeless Mediterranean-inspired architecture, the home welcomes you with a private entry, lush tropical landscaping, and an inviting curb appeal. The thoughtfully designed floor plan offers generous living and dining spaces filled with natural light, rich wood flooring, and a private elevator providing easy access to every level. A flexible den or office creates the ideal space for working from home, a media room, or additional living area. The upper levels feature all three bedrooms, all en-suite with their own bathrooms and large closet space. The main living level includes a well-equipped kitchen, powder room, laundry room, and open-concept living spaces perfect for both entertaining and everyday comfort. A two-car garage provides added convenience and storage. Enjoy a prime East Boca location just moments from the beach, downtown Boca Raton, Mizner Park, premier shopping, dining, and highly rated schools. An exceptional opportunity to own in one of Boca Raton's most convenient and sought-after gated communities.
